title: cc-docker project config
description: Schema for .cc-docker/cc-docker.yml — consumed by the cc-config tool (toolchain/config/generate-compose.py) to generate .cc-docker/docker-compose.yml. See the README section 'Configuring cc-docker' for details.

image.description: Docker image to run as the `cc` service, e.g. cc-node20.

git.description: Git identity to configure inside the container.

name.description: Value for git's user.name, exposed to the container as GIT_USER_NAME.

email.description: Value for git's user.email, exposed to the container as GIT_USER_EMAIL.

env.description: Extra environment variables merged into the `cc` service.

readonly.description: If true, all project bind mounts declared in `mounts` are mounted read-only.

mounts.description: Project paths to bind-mount into the container.

path.description: Path to mount, relative to the project root. Use "." to mount the whole project root.

exclude.description: Glob patterns (relative to this mount) to shadow out with a tmpfs (directories) or a read-only /dev/null bind (files).

extra_mounts.description: Raw docker compose volume entries, appended verbatim to the generated `volumes` list. No further validation is applied.
